description_en: Enables the Autoscaler feature and creates an Autoscaler controller for a service
description_zh: 开通服务自动扩缩容功能，为服务创建自动扩缩控制器
kebab_example: aliyun eas create-service-auto-scaler --cluster-id cn-shanghai --service-name foo --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateServiceAutoScaler

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the service is deployed
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The service name. For more information about how to query the service name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.help_zh: 服务名称。如何查看服务名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.name: service_name

fields.help_en: The time window that is required before the number of instances is reduced to 0. The number of instances can be reduced to 0 only if no request is available or no traffic exists in the specified time window. Default value: 600
fields.help_zh:
缩容到0之前的等待期。
当指标满足缩容到0的条件时，需要经过等待期的时间，才会执行缩容到0。默认值为600
fields.name: scale_down_grace_period_seconds

fields.help_en: The number of instances that you want to create at a time if the number of instances is 0. Default value: 1
fields.help_zh: 当从0开始扩容时，一次性创建的实例数。默认值为1
fields.name: scale_up_activation_replicas

fields.help_en: The operation that reduces the number of instances to 0
fields.name: on_zero

fields.help_en: The time window that is required before the scale-in operation is performed. The scale-in operation can be performed only if the specified metric drops below the specified threshold in the specified time window. Default value: 300
fields.help_zh:
缩容稳定窗口期时间，默认值为300。
只有当过去一段时间内的指标均不满足条件，才会执行缩容
fields.name: stabilization_window_seconds

fields.help_en: The time window that is required before the scale-out operation is performed. The scale-out operation can be performed only if the specified metric exceeds the specified threshold in the specified time window. Default value: 0
fields.help_zh:
扩容稳定窗口期时间，默认值为0。
只有当过去一段时间内的指标均满足条件，才会执行扩容
fields.name: stabilization_window_seconds

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of instances in the service. The value of max must be greater than the value of min
parameters.help_zh: 最大实例数，需要大于Min Replica
parameters.name: max

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of instances in the service
parameters.name: min

fields.help_en:
The name of the metric for triggering auto scaling. Valid values:

qps: the queries per second (qps) for an individual instance.

cpu: the cpu utilization.

gpu[util]: gpu utilization
fields.help_zh:
指标名称，取值如下：
qps：单实例qps伸缩阈值。
cpu：cpu利用率阈值。
gpu[util]：gpu利用率阈值
fields.name: metric_name

fields.help_en: The service for which the metric is specified. If you do not set this parameter, the current service is specified by default
fields.help_zh: 指标所属服务，不配置默认为当前服务
fields.name: service

fields.help_en:
The threshold of the metric that triggers auto scaling.

If you set metricName to qps, scale-out is triggered when the average qps for a single instance is greater than this threshold.

If you set metricName to cpu, scale-out is triggered when the average cpu utilization for a single instance is greater than this threshold.

If you set metricName to gpu, scale-out is triggered when the average gpu utilization for a single instance is greater than this threshold
fields.help_zh:
触发自动伸缩阈值。
指标名称配置为qps：当单实例的平均qps大于该值时会触发扩容。
指标名称配置为cpu：当单实例的平均cpu使用率大于该值时会触发扩容。
指标名称配置为gpu[util]：当单实例的平均gpu使用率大于该值时会触发扩容
fields.name: threshold

parameters.help_en: The service for which the metric is specified. If you do not set this parameter, the current service is specified by default
parameters.name: scale_strategies
